k2.title: K2 Streams
k2.description: Create and manage durable streams for your event data.
k2.empty_description: Create a stream to start storing event data.
k2.no_results_description: Try a different name or clear your search.
k2.name: Stream name
k2.name_help: Use 1–128 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Names cannot be changed after creation.
k2.name_invalid: Enter 1–128 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores.
k2.retention_help: How long to retain data in the stream. Minimum 1 hour; default 7 days.
k2.retention_invalid: Enter a duration of at least 1 hour, up to %{max}.
k2.worker_binding_help: Always enabled. Send data directly from a Cloudflare Worker using a binding to this stream.
k2.http_help: Send data to this stream’s HTTPS endpoint from applications and services.
k2.authentication_help: Require a valid API token for requests to the HTTP endpoint.
k2.unauthenticated: Anyone with the endpoint URL can send data when authentication is disabled.
k2.cors_description: Choose which websites can send browser requests to this stream. Origin restrictions do not apply to non-browser clients.
k2.all_origins_authenticated: Any website can send requests to this stream. A valid API token is still required.
k2.all_origins_unauthenticated: Any website can write to this stream without authentication.
k2.cors_help: Add up to 5 HTTP or HTTPS origins. Leave the list empty to block cross-origin browser requests.
k2.cors_invalid: Enter up to 5 unique HTTP or HTTPS origins without paths, credentials, queries, or fragments.
k2.cors_keyboard: Enter adds a row. Backspace removes an empty row. Tab moves between controls.
k2.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
k2.duplicate: A stream with this name already exists. Choose another name.
k2.read_only: You have read-only access to K2 streams.
k2.delete_description: Permanently delete this stream and its data. Applications using the stream will no longer be able to send or read data.
k2.delete_failed: The stream could not be deleted. Try again.
k2.edit_description: Update retention and input settings for %{name}.
